authoritative_source: OpenFlights routes (ODbL) + OurAirports (Public Domain) + GeoNames (CC BY 4.0)
connectivity_density: 16,701 direct corridors over 2,522 air-connected cities; mean degree 13.2
family_intent: MEASURED in en, de and fr
serp_evidence: rome2rio holds 1,850,129 organic keywords on exactly this model, 589,488 in positions 1 to 3
commercial_value: HIGH, a traveller on a corridor is an eSIM buyer
utility_gate: graph edge required; both endpoints above a population floor; at least 3 statable facts; one page per unordered pair
why_each_cell_is_unique: Distance, the airports that serve the corridor, the number of independent operators evidencing it, and for one-transfer pairs the viable hubs and the detour each adds. All computed per pair from the graph.

connectivity_density: 280,733 adjacency statements exist globally; per-country fetch in progress
family_intent: MEASURED in de ("berlin hamburg zug" is the canonical form)
utility_gate: same as air, plus a bounded path length through the station graph
estimated_legitimate_capacity: NOT YET MEASURED. Rail connects far more European city pairs than air and at shorter distances air does not serve, so this is the largest single unknown in the plan.
why_each_cell_is_unique: The station sequence, the line, the number of intermediate stops and the distance differ per pair.

connectivity_density: 3,354 access relations, one per airport with a resolvable city
family_intent: MEASURED, "heathrow to london" 1,300 and "heathrow to paddington" 1,000
commercial_value: HIGH, arrival is when connectivity is bought
utility_gate: airport within 60km of the city; city above a population floor
why_each_cell_is_unique: The airport to city distance, the IATA code and the airport class. Ground transport operators and fares are NOT stated because no licensed source for them is on disk.

serp_evidence: an own distinct intent, not a flight pair
utility_gate: both airports serving one metro area and a real surface connection
why_each_cell_is_unique: Inter-airport distance and the surface options between two specific terminals.
evidence_status: MEASURED intent, NOT built. Found during this research and not previously modelled.

authoritative_source: each government foreign ministry; UK FCDO via the gov.uk content API under OGL v3 is captured
connectivity_density: every nationality by every destination has a policy, so density is 1
avg_unique_facts_per_cell: 4, the requirement class, passport validity months, blank pages and the authority
family_intent: MEASURED, 107 rows and about 90 destinations for US citizens alone at a 200 floor
serp_evidence: head terms 3,600 down to 200 across destinations
commercial_value: VERY HIGH, directly adjacent to the purchase
duplicate_risk: MEDIUM, many destinations share one policy, so identical policy clusters must roll up
utility_gate: an authoritative source per cell, a review date, and no legal guarantee
estimated_legitimate_capacity: 226 per nationality captured. The bound is the number of nationalities for which an authoritative source exists, NOT 200 x 226.
why_each_cell_is_unique: A different legal requirement: a US citizen needs an e-visa for India, an ETA for the UK and nothing for Mexico. That is a different answer, not a template.
evidence_status: MEASURED and in capture for GB.

utility_gate: a sourced, cell-specific fact set; a cell whose only difference is the name is rejected
why_each_cell_is_unique: Only if the page states registry facts for that company at that location: incorporation date, filing status, officers. Where it would only restate a name and an address it is a directory listing and is rejected.
evidence_status: NOT MEASURED. No licensed register on disk.

authoritative_source: salary and vacancy sources, mostly licensed
utility_gate: a sourced, cell-specific fact set; a cell whose only difference is the name is rejected
why_each_cell_is_unique: Only if a measured local salary distribution or vacancy count exists for that profession in that city. Livdar already holds salary data for a limited set; without it the cell is a city name swap and is rejected.
evidence_status: PARTLY MEASURED. The existing work surface finals 3,921, which is the honest size at current data.

utility_gate: a sourced, cell-specific fact set; a cell whose only difference is the name is rejected
why_each_cell_is_unique: Only if the page states course-level facts: duration, entry requirements, fees, language of instruction. A university name plus a course name is not a page.

utility_gate: a sourced, cell-specific fact set; a cell whose only difference is the name is rejected
why_each_cell_is_unique: Only where waiting times, service availability or accreditation differ per hospital and service. In most countries that data is not open.

evidence_status: PARTLY MEASURED. events surface finals 6,680 per family.
